documents.title: Sync field entries
documents.text: On mobile, open Settings and choose Sync now. A green check beside an entry means its latest changes are backed up.

documents.title: Customer voice
documents.text: Use short sentences. Refer to a field entry by its name in the app.

documents.title: Protect offline work
documents.text: When troubleshooting synchronization, preserve the local copy of each field entry.
